# Meta-skills and orchestration

Practice-ID: BP-META-001
Scope: mixed
Status: current
Sources: SRC-EX-001, SRC-EX-002, SRC-LOCAL-001, SRC-DER-001
Last-rebuilt: 2026-07-30

Separate roles:

- scout discovers worthwhile opportunities;
- harvester collects evidence and context;
- creator builds coherent packages;
- doctor diagnoses and verifies recovery;
- optimizer runs measured improvements;
- refactor changes capability topology;
- manager owns lifecycle state;
- builder coordinates end-to-end scenarios;
- best-practices maintainer refreshes the evidence corpus.

Orchestrators should hold phase state and bounded handoffs, not duplicate specialist judgment. Every handoff names target, objective, evidence, scope, authority, preserved invariants, required output, exit checks, and forbidden side effects.

Adapt useful `skillify` patterns: worth gate, coherent trigger family, completeness audit, quality-before-tests, natural trigger fixtures, resolver/catalog coexistence, E2E verification, structured audit, idempotency, and resumption. Do not universalize fixed thresholds, model providers, host commands, or one checklist score.

Protect meta-evaluation: creator, optimizer, evaluator, and deployer remain logically separable; holdout stays hidden; one hypothesis changes per iteration; changed scripts run; catalog regressions are mandatory; self-referential loops have hard budgets; proposals include diff, evidence, rollback, and installation status.
